items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Darnell talks about the theater jobs and then the late jobs.

ctx.x: That may very well have been. I hadn't thought of that. The Deleuze used to stay on till 10.

Of course, there may have been such things as swing shift business. I don't know. But, uh, half a dozen of the fellows on the south side were moonlighters working two jobs. Jimmy Noon was one. He worked over here at the ballroom, uh, on the west side, uh, Dreamland ballroom. And then would go down to the Apex Club for a couple of hours. And, uh, Oliver had, on many occasions, had two jobs. Darnell talks about the theater jobs and then the late jobs. Well, these late jobs, uh, may have been, um, late shows, uh,…
